h2. Description

*When a user who may only view work orders tries to drag a card or row to another technician, the note "You don't have permission to assign technicians" should show at the top of that technician's column or group.* On staging nothing shows, so the user gets no explanation.

For example,
* the user presses on a card and moves the mouse to another technician's column: the card is not picked up, the mouse only highlights the card's text, and no note appears
* the same in Tech View on a row moved over another technician's group
* nothing is changed, which is correct — only the explanation is missing

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Go to your initials > *Settings* > *Roles & Permissions* and make a role whose *Work orders* permission has only *View* ticked. Give it to a staff member at this location (Settings > Staff).
# Make two *Approved* work orders for one customer, both with the same lead technician, and make sure a second technician is active at this location.
# Sign in as the view-only user. Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, click *Board View*, and type the customer's name in *Search*.
# Press on one of the cards and, keeping the mouse button down, move it over the second technician's column.
#* The card does not move with the mouse; its text gets highlighted.
#* No note appears at the top of the second technician's column.
# Let go.
#* The card stays where it was (correct).
# Click *Tech View* and do the same with the row, over the second technician's group.
#* Again no note appears.

*Actual Result:*
* No note shows anywhere. The card or row is simply not picked up, and the user is not told why.

*Expected Result:*
* The PRD says: *"A user without it who drags a card or row over another technician’s column or group sees the design’s note “You don’t have permission to assign technicians” at the top of that column or group, and the drop is refused."*
